requirement.description: The hand-over from observability to performance monitoring has no trigger. The hand-over is currently set to wait for a manual request before it runs.
requirement.fact: The hand-over from observability to performance monitoring has no trigger.
requirement.reading: The hand-over is currently set to wait for a manual request before it runs.

narrator.name: Reliability Ruth
narrator.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something does not exist. Describe only how the work is done today without it, as observed events or numbers. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: The transition from the observability phase to active performance monitoring does not start on its own. It sits idle until a human sends a request. I watched the system during last Tuesday's deployment. The observability checks finished at 14:00, but the performance monitoring suite did not begin until 16:30. The gap existed because no one had triggered the switch. The logs show a manual command entered by an engineer at that time. Without that specific input, the monitoring tools remain in a waiting state. The system does not detect the completion of observability tasks and initiate the next step by itself. It relies entirely on an external signal to proceed.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the system's operational behavior and a specific observed event without expressing any wishes, refusals, or trade-offs.
